archive_files.evidence: WebDAV PROPFIND Multi-Status 207 response parsed into exact file entries and byte lengths.
archive_files.notes: Component is composed of exactly 3 split tar.gz archives.

split_structure.value: Independent archives strictly divided by split: training, validation, testing
split_structure.evidence: Filenames orig_training.tar.gz, orig_validation.tar.gz, orig_testing.tar.gz match split taxonomy.
split_structure.notes: No monolithic single orig archive exists upstream.

download_separate_splits.evidence: HEAD query returned HTTP 200 with Content-Length 859947874 and Content-Type application/gzip.
download_separate_splits.notes: Allows downloading validation split (859.9 MB) or testing split (806.9 MB) without downloading full 7.32 GB.

download_separate_categories.evidence: Upstream /orig/ folder contains only the 3 split tar.gz archives; category subdirectories are packed inside.
download_separate_categories.notes: Category filtering must occur post-extraction locally.

download_individual_images.evidence: Individual images are encapsulated inside tar.gz archives and are not exposed as discrete WebDAV resources.
download_individual_images.notes: Selective image access requires extracting the split archive.

dynamic_zip_mechanism.value: Triggered when requesting folder root /download?path=%2F&files=orig; static gzip returned when targeting specific archive
dynamic_zip_mechanism.evidence: Folder download returns 303 to /orig?accept=zip with Content-Length: None; single file download returns direct static gzip with exact Content-Length.
dynamic_zip_mechanism.notes: Static archive download avoids server-side zip recompression delays.

resume_support.evidence: Nextcloud returns Accept-Ranges: None on public share direct download.
resume_support.notes: Interrupted downloads cannot resume via Range header and must restart from .part.
